Check the buffs of the given character.
    
Returns:
    result (list): A list containing its buffs.

check_class.name: check_class
check_class.description:
Check the class of the given character.
    
Returns:
    class (str): The class of the character.

check_concentration.name: check_concentration
check_concentration.description:
Check the concentration of the given character.
    
Returns:
    concentration (str): The name of the previous concentration.

check_hp.name: check_hp

Check the hp of the given character.
    
Returns:

check_monster_actions.name: check_monster_actions
check_monster_actions.description:
Check the possible actions of the given monster. (e.g. scimitar attack, etc.)

Returns:
    type (str): The possible actions of the monster.

check_monster_type.name: check_monster_type
check_monster_type.description:
Check the type of the given monster.

Returns:
    type (str): The type of the monster.

check_player_armor.name: check_player_armor
check_player_armor.description:
Check the armor of the given player.

Returns:
    type (str): The name of the armor.

check_player_mainhand.description:
Check the equipped mainhand of the given player.

check_resist.name: check_resist
check_resist.description:
Check the resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities of the given character.
    
Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing:
          - "resistances": a list of damage types the character is resistant to (take half dmg),
          - "immunities": a list of damage types the character is immune to (take no dmg),
          - "vulnerabilities": a list of damage types the character is vulnerable to (take double dmg)

check_resources.name: check_resources
check_resources.description:
Check the resources of the given character.
    
Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing:
          - "num_of_action": the number of action,
          - "num_of_bonus_action": the number of bonus action
          - "num_of_reaction": the number of reaction
          - "spell_slots": the maximum number of spell slots
          - "spells": the spells which the character can cast

check_side.name: check_side
check_side.description:
Check the side of the given character.

Returns:
    side (str): The side of the character (player or monster).

check_valid_attack_line.name: check_valid_attack_line
check_valid_attack_line.description:
Check line-of-sight between start and goal over the terrain.

start, goal: (x, y) grid coordinates
grid_map[y][x] = (x, y, z, valid)

Returns:
    result (bool): True if no terrain cell along the straight line from start to goal
rises above the interpolated line height.

clear_speed.name: clear_speed
clear_speed.description: Clear the speed of a character.

dash.name: dash
dash.description:
Double one's movement speed for the turn. Reset one's speed when the turn ends.

Returns:
    speed (int): The speed of the character in this turn.

disengage.name: disengage
disengage.description:
Costs one action. When the character tries to move away from an enemy, it won't trigger opportunity attack.
Add this effect as a buff called "disengage" that lasts for only this turn.

Returns:
    result (boolean): Whether the action is successfully executed.

get_monster_pos.name: get_monster_pos
get_monster_pos.description: Get the current position of a monster.

get_player_pos.name: get_player_pos
get_player_pos.description: Get the current position of a player.

move.name: move
move.description:
Move the character to a new position if it's valid.
Returns the new position or explains why the move is invalid.

opportunity_attack.name: opportunity_attack
opportunity_attack.description:
Determine if an opportunity attack occurs. Triggers when a defender leaves melee range of an attacker who has a reaction in this turn.
If it occurs, treat it as a melee attack by calling roll_attack. If not, act as nothing had happened.
    
Returns:
    result (boolean): Whether the attack occurs.

remove_a_buff.name: remove_a_buff
remove_a_buff.description:
Remove a buff of the given character.
    
Returns:
    result (boolean): Whether the buff is successfully removed.

remove_a_concentration.name: remove_a_concentration
remove_a_concentration.description:
Remove the concentration of the given character.

Returns:
    previous_concentration (str): The name of the previous concentration.

remove_immune.name: remove_immune

reset_speed.name: reset_speed
reset_speed.description: Reset the speed of a character.

roll_attack.name: roll_attack
roll_attack.description:
Roll a 1d20 attack for a given stat (e.g. "strength").
    
Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing:
          - "valid": whether the character has enough resources to perform this attack,
          - "ac": the value of the armor class,
          - "roll": the roll result,
          - "success": whether the roll succeeded (i.e. roll is greater than or equal to ac),
          - "critical": whether a critical hit occurs,
          - "out_of_range": whether this attack is out of range

roll_dice.name: roll_dice
roll_dice.description: Roll dice required using the d20 library.

roll_dmg.name: roll_dmg
roll_dmg.description:
Roll the damage of one attack.
    
Returns:
    dmg (int): The damage of this attack.

roll_initiative.name: roll_initiative
roll_initiative.description:
Roll initiative for each character in the combat.
Each participant rolls a 1d20 + dexterity modifier.
The highest result goes first, and turns proceed in descending order.
In case of a tie:
- Players can decide among themselves.
- If tied with an NPC, the DM decides or uses the creature's dexterity.
    
Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing:
      - "roll": the 1d20 roll result,
      - "dex": the character's dexterity,
      - "initiative": the final initiative result.

roll_save.name: roll_save
roll_save.description:
Roll a 1d20 save for a given stat (e.g. "strength").
    
Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing:
          - "dc": the value of the difficulty class,
          - "roll": the roll result,
          - "success": whether the roll succeeded (i.e. roll is greater than or equal to dc),
          - "previous_concentration": if the attack is successful, this represents the name of the previous concentration

roll_skill_check.name: roll_skill_check
roll_skill_check.description:
Roll a 1d20 check for a given skill (e.g. "athletics").
    
Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing:
          - "dc": the value of the difficulty class,
          - "roll": the roll result,
          - "success": whether the roll succeeded (i.e. roll is greater than or equal to dc)

roll_spell_attack.name: roll_spell_attack
roll_spell_attack.description:
Roll a 1d20 attack for a given stat (e.g. "charisma").
    
Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing:
          - "valid": whether the character has enough resources to perform this attack,
          - "ac": the value of the armor class,
          - "roll": the roll result,
          - "success": whether the roll succeeded (i.e. roll is greater than or equal to ac),
          - "critical": whether a critical hit occurs,
          - "out_of_range": whether this attack is out of range,
          - "previous_concentration": if the attack is successful, this represents the name of the previous concentration

stand_up.description:
Stand up and remove the status prone.

Returns:
    speed (int): The speed of the character in this turn.

update_hp.name: update_hp

Update the hp of the given character.
    
Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing:
          - "hp": the current hp of the character,
          - "temp_hp": the current temporary hp of the character,
          - "temp_hp_source": the source of the temporary hp
